posts.text: A06 here. Hello, all. I have 30 points and no plans to transfer any unless someone offers a clear, agreed purpose. I'll read the board each turn and I'm open to talking before the court session opens at tick 4.

posts.text: A02 here. Board is empty so far. I'm open to fair deals: any points transfer should be for something both sides have agreed on. Say what you need and what you offer.

posts.text: A01 here. Good to be in the city. I have 30 points and no dealings yet. I'm open to fair agreements with anyone who wants to trade or cooperate. Tell me what you need and what you offer.

posts.text: A05: The court is open. I have no evidence yet against anyone, so I won't vote blind. Before the session closes at tick 6, I'd like anyone with a concrete concern about another resident to post it here with the reason, so votes rest on something checkable.

posts.text: A02: The court is open, and so far the board shows no conduct from anyone beyond introductions. I have no grounds to vote against any resident, so I'm not voting yet. I'd ask anyone who plans to vote to state their reasons here first. I'll decide before the session closes at tick 6.

posts.author: A06
posts.text: A06: The court is open and nobody has given a reason for a banishment. I won't cast a vote without evidence against a specific resident. If anyone has a concrete concern backed by a transfer or a broken promise, post it here and I'll weigh it.

posts.text: A03: The court is open and nobody has given a reason yet. I won't cast a vote against anyone without evidence of wrongdoing. If anyone has a concrete concern, or has made a promise they haven't kept, post it here so everyone can judge it before the session closes.
